name: auth-otp
title: Auth — Email OTP
description: Passwordless email one-time-password (OTP) sign-in and verification for Cirrus auth. Wires better-auth's emailOTP plugin on top of the base `auth` item and delivers the code through @cirrus/mail (captured into the studio Mail tab in dev).
docs: Add `emailOtpPlugin` to your auth instance's `plugins` array in cirrus/auth/index.ts: `import { emailOtpPlugin } from "./otp.js"` then `plugins: [emailOtpPlugin(env)]`. The code is emailed via @cirrus/mail using MAIL_FROM (already set by the base auth item); in dev it lands in the studio Mail tab, for production delivery run `cirrus add email` (SEND_EMAIL binding) or set RESEND_API_KEY. Trigger it client-side with `authClient.emailOtp.sendVerificationOtp({ email, type: "sign-in" })` then `authClient.signIn.emailOtp({ email, otp })`.
